desc: Ideation/algorithm selection completed (functional-graph formula chosen and validated).

Run and confirm outputs on all four samples (4, 0, -1, 4) -- SAMPLE TESTS PASSED.

Verify adversarial edge cases by hand and against code logic: all-26 single 26-cycle -> -1; all-26 2-cycle + fixed point with incoming (case b) -> 4 (explicit 4-op sequence d->c, a->d, b->a, d->b confirmed); all-26 2-cycle + fixed point with no incoming -> -1; N=1 a->a -> 0 and a->b -> 1; conflict -> -1; S==T -> 0; 3-rotary abac->bcba -> 4.
Confirm spare condition uses image-size (f not injective) which is equivalent to existence of a freeable non-cycle label; validated against case where a non-fixed node has in-degree 2.
